[[File:Goethar_Special.jpg|250px|thumb|''Goethar Special'']]
'''''Goethar Special''''' was a unique swoop bike, a replica of the bike of the legendary swoop champion [[Goethar Kleej]], painted in his signature colors. In [[3963 BBY]] the bike was set to be a prize for the winner of the [[Tandem Open]], set on [[Jervo's World]]. [[Rohlan Dyre]] eventually won the Tandem Finals, and the bike became his, though he didn't know what to do with it and eventually let [[Zayne Carrick]] borrow it. Zayne took it to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with him.
